title: BadAction: Backdoor Attacks on Interactive Video Generation via Action-Guided Triggers
abstract: arXiv:2609.39047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive video generation (IVG) models have achieved remarkable progress in producing controllable visual content guided by user-defined actions, yet their security vulnerabilities remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of backdoor attacks against the interactivity of IVG models. Based on this attack surface, we propose BadAction, which leverages action-guided triggers to achieve the attack. Specifically, BadAction implants predefined motion patterns into the action sequences of backdoor samples and associates them with a static target video. Once triggered, the backdoored model generates frozen future frames that no longer respond to subsequent user actions, while preserving normal behavior on benign action sequences. In addition, we explore a stealthier attack in which multimodal triggers jointly poison action, text, and image inputs. Experiments show that BadAction achieves average attack

translated_title: BadAction：通过动作引导触发器对交互式视频生成实施后门攻击
translated_abstract: 交互式视频生成（IVG）模型在根据用户自定义动作生成可控视觉内容方面取得了显著进展，但其安全漏洞在很大程度上尚未被探索。本文首次对针对IVG模型交互性的后门攻击进行了系统性研究。基于这一攻击面，我们提出了BadAction，它利用动作引导的触发器来实现攻击。具体而言，BadAction将预定义的运动模式植入后门样本的动作序列中，并将其与一个静态目标视频相关联。一旦被触发，植入后门的模型会生成冻结的未来帧，不再响应后续的用户动作，同时在良性动作序列上保持正常行为。此外，我们探索了一种更隐蔽的攻击方式，即多模态触发器联合污染动作、文本和图像输入。实验表明，BadAction实现了平均攻击（成功率……）
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了交互式视频生成模型的后门攻击，提出BadAction方法，通过在动作序列中植入预定义运动模式作为触发器，使被攻击模型生成不再响应用户动作的冻结画面，并可通过多模态触发器实现更隐蔽的攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of backdoor attacks on interactive video generation models, proposing BadAction, which implants predefined motion patterns as action-guided triggers to make the backdoored model generate frozen frames unresponsive to user actions, with stealthier variants using multimodal triggers.
